0.literal: Once we go in, there's no turning back.
0.official: There's no turning back once we're in...

1.literal: You may get challenged to a Money Battle.
1.official: This is exactly when you need to keep watch for one of the Five Billionaires picking a Money Battle.

2.literal: Anyway, increase your properties, help them grow,
2.official: Basically, you want to expand your holdings, grow those properties,

3.literal: Also, the operating funds you've built up...
3.official: Oh, one other thing. I'm leaving it up to you how to spend any profits and operating capital.

4.literal: Please use them wisely, including to better yourself.
4.official: Invest wisely. That includes investing in yourself.

5.literal: I can't think of anything to use this much money on right away, but...
5.official: I don't see how I'm going to spend this much money anytime soon, but thanks.

6.literal: I can already tell the road ahead is going to be rough.
6.official: I see a lot of headaches in my future.

7.literal: ...Anyway, now that I've taken this on, I'd better give it my all.
7.official: Ah, well. I agreed to do this. I'm going all in.

8.literal: Once a set amount of time has passed after you order a profit collection,
8.official: A set time after giving the order to begin collections in a given area, you'll be able to pick up those profits.

9.literal: Oh, and also, as your initial operating funds,
9.official: Oh, and Yamanoi-san left me some funds to serve as your initial operating capital.

10.literal: It's a farewell gift from me, so please go ahead and use it.
10.official: That nest egg and Yurizake down on the first floor of this building are my little sendoff to you. Please, use them with my blessing.

11.literal: That said, running just one shop is a bit precarious.
11.official: Though relying on a single shop's profits is putting a lot of eggs in one basket.

13.literal: Somewhere like "Sukiyaki Muranaka" would be my recommendation.
13.official: If you want a solid starter, I'd recommend Sukiyaki Muranaka, on Tenkaichi Street.

14.literal: Looks like you need some new music.
14.official: Thought you could use some new music!

15.literal: The music that plays is set with the boombox in your hideout or your home.
15.official: Use the boombox in your home or hideout to change the music on the tape.

16.literal: With a Walkman, you can listen to your favorite songs while walking around town.
16.official: A Walkman lets you listen to your favorite music as you walk around town.

18.official: You got a Stone of Enduring.

19.official: You got the Hannya Tattoo outfit.

20.official: You got the Dragon Tattoo outfit.

21.literal: Received the "Mad Dog of Shimano" change-of-clothes outfit.
21.official: You got the Mad Dog of Shimano outfit.

30.official: You got 50 pieces of Quality Iron.

31.official: You got three Demon Face Stones.

32.official: You got a Super Spicy Knife.

40.literal: Also, I'm only giving you the item pack once.
40.official: You're only getting this once, so take good care of it.

41.literal: the "Dragon of Dojima Pack" or the "Sotenbori Enjoy Pack"...
41.official: if you have the Dragon of Dojima Pack or Sotenbori Fun Pack

42.literal: Does Talk_Quest without looking at the player.

43.literal: Standby is also set to not look at the player.

44.literal: Hey, the Dojima Family's scrambling around again...
44.official: Hey, the Dojima Family's going nuts right now...

45.literal: Depending on how it turns out, not just the Dojima Family but the Tojo Clan's whole balance of power
45.official: Depending on how this shakes out, it could mean big changes in the Dojima power structure. Or the Tojo's...

46.literal: might end up getting drastically redrawn...
46.official: it could mean big changes in the Dojima power structure. Or the Tojo's...

47.official: Tell all our men to clear out of the Tenkaichi Street area!

48.literal: Whatever happens, once the gang war's over, the town will quiet down.
48.official: Whoever wins, things'll quiet down once it's over.

49.literal: How can you say something so carefree...
49.official: How can you be so relaxed about it?

50.literal: ...My brother was kidnapped by the Dojima Family? No way!?
50.official: No... The Dojima Family's got my brother!?

51.literal: But I'll bring him back for sure... even if it costs me my life.
51.official: but I swear I'll bring him back to you... even if it kills me.

52.literal: Um... it really is a shabby place, but...
52.official: Er... Sorry the place ain't anything fit to show a lady.

54.literal: Orders from up top. They said to take you out as soon as we find you.
54.official: The men upstairs decided they're tired of dealing with your crap. Kill on sight, they said.

55.literal: After Tachibana egged you into picking a fight with Dojima,
55.official: You let Tachibana talk you into picking a fight with Dojima,

56.literal: they went and kicked the ladder out from under you.
56.official: then got the rug pulled out from under you.

57.literal: Low-level guys like us haven't been told.
57.official: They're not telling us rank-and-file guys.

58.literal: It seems Oda had been leaking information.
58.official: It seems that Oda was leaking information to him.

59.literal: He probably meant to swoop in and snatch her away.
59.official: I assume his plan was to let Tachibana-san do the work of finding Makoto Makimura, then swoop in and take her.

60.literal: I had even thought of making that boy my successor.
60.official: I'd even considered naming the boy my successor.

61.literal: ...I truly want to help him, from the bottom of my heart.
61.official: I do want to help him. Truly.

62.literal: After the war, he was forced to give up his land...
62.official: After the war, hard times forced him to sell off most of his property.

63.literal: But according to the records, he negotiated with four buyers at once
63.official: But records show that he negotiated with four different buyers

64.literal: and went out of his way to split the land into pieces and sell it.
64.official: to deliberately sell the land off in small parcels.

65.literal: Most likely, he did it intentionally so that just one tsubo
65.official: Most likely, in order to retain the rights to one small sliver of it.

66.literal: would stay in his own hands.
66.official: Most likely, in order to retain the rights to one small sliver of it.

67.literal: At that time, Genzo Makimura had a daughter he'd been separated from in China.
67.official: At the time, Genzo Makimura had a daughter living in China, though they were separated.

69.literal: If we were to act directly, Little Asia would no longer be tolerated by the Tojo Clan
69.official: Yet if we were to take direct action against Dojima, the Tojo Clan would doubtless no longer suffer Little Asia to exist.

70.literal: I'll rescue Tachibana, no matter what...!
70.official: I'll get Tachibana out, whatever it takes!

71.literal: Even if it hurts... we have no choice but to leave it to you.
71.official: However badly they may still hurt, you must assist us in this task.

72.literal: His body has gotten weaker compared to before.

73.literal: His condition temporarily took a turn for the worse for about two days, but...
73.official: His condition got pretty bad for a couple of days...

74.literal: I apologize... I meant to tell you once everything was settled.
74.official: Then I owe you a second apology. I was planning to tell you everything once this was settled.
